description: Get a rebalancing recommendation for an Arcadia account: suggests asset changes to optimize yield. current_apy and proposed_apy are measured over the last 24 hours where possible (the account's positions at their own ranges, the proposal at its ranges), not the 7-day average of read_strategy_list, so recommended strategies may differ from the list ranking. APY values are decimal fractions (0.05 = 5%). weekly_earning_difference is in USD.
name: read_strategy_recommendation
